title: I entered mallworld from outside of it and saw it open
content: There was so much that happened in this dream it's hard to exactly have a concise plotline about.. but I was outside, went to a glasses repair place cause my glasses were broken or something (and also were this weird wrought iron and wooden contraption?) and they fixed them but did it really shittily. I'm walking around a park, cross a railroad that cuts through it. Inspect the glasses and the screws and weird screw cap things they put on it started to fall off. I tried to get them back off the ground with a magnet but only got up different screws instead. Carried my glasses, hoping to find the glasses repair place again. They continued to fall apart from me simply walking around. Everyone was looking at me weird as I walked and would be like "how does she have those glasses" or "what even is that contraption she's holding" or "how does she even exist". I ignored it all, walked across the railroad again, and saw the building where the glasses place was but it was like... undefined? There was no sign, I just knew it was the same shape. I went in and suddenly there was tons of people. I look around and notice that my vision is weird but also that I kinda don't need glasses now (surprisingly still didn't understand this was a dream). As I go through this crowd of people, most of them are going into these doors for a giant grocery store. Like, can't see the end of it kinda space. I walk past them and end up in the mall finally, but like the entrance. Which seems to weirdly be... kinda like, private? There weren't many people around. I looked at my phone and saw the time was 8am. I remember thinking "I didn't think malls opened this early". I then see three giant glass and metal doors in front of me. One to the left and one in front of me. There is one to the right but it has busted glass windows and the metal bars are bent as if it was broken. I see someone exit and carefully close a tiny door that seemed to morph out of the giant door on the left, they were whispering to their coworker(?) "I think they're comfortable now". They looked at me and then put their head down and hand over their eyes like they were afraid of me recognizing them or something. I walked toward the center door cause I want to go into the mall (I've entirely forgotten about my glasses now) and as I get close to the door I see some little sign hung on the door, blue outline and grey text but when I tried to read it I woke up. Time when I woke up was 6:45am. I guess I saw the gates to the mallworld and it opens at 8am in dream time lol.
